summary: Correct existing BFF Consultation owner authentication and readback. Wired operator-bff machine token in docker-compose.yml, resolved verified caller tenant using existing OwnerReadContextMiddleware and bound_tenant in owner_reads.py, bound Consultation client with machine auth and verified tenant in operations_consultation.py without swallowing owner errors or falling back to local store, routed Workshop canonical consultation transport through shared ConsultationServiceClient with machine auth and caller tenant, and proved with real in-repo Consultation HTTP owner tests addressing B1-B4 factual return items.

verification_proofs.B1_strict_bff_auth_enforcement: Strict app_factory rejects unsigned synthetic JWT with 401; genuine dev-login creates authenticated operator and viewer sessions with verified tenant scopes.
verification_proofs.B2_overlapping_tenant_isolation_and_empt: Real concurrent requests across tenants synchronize simultaneously (observed overlap >= 2) with strict isolation, and querying empty tenant returns empty list without store mutation.
verification_proofs.B3_machine_auth_visible_error: Genuine consultation server authentication rejects wrong machine token with 403 DOWNSTREAM_AUTH_ERROR and missing token with 401/403 DOWNSTREAM_AUTH_ERROR without store fallback or false 404.
verification_proofs.B4_workshop_canonical_transport: Workshop canonical consultation transport verified with genuine HTTP positive through running Consultation server, tenant mismatch negative, and ConsultationServiceClient interceptor.
verification_proofs.tenant_mismatch_rejected: Foreign tenant in X-Selected-Tenant or body mismatch rejected with 403 TENANT_MISMATCH before owner call
verification_proofs.outage_and_malformed_visible_error: Connection failure / malformed JSON returns visible 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE without fallback to local store
